enchantments.tooltip: Charisma +9: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Evocation Focus +6: +6 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.

Shield +9: While this item is equipped, you are partially protected by a field of magical force which can deflect enemy attacks. This item provides a +9 Shield bonus to Armor Class. It does not stack with an equipped shield.
Efficient Metamagic - Maximize II: The additional spell point cost for using the Maximize Metamagic feat is reduced by 4 SP.
